title: Intern - HR
description:
**About MISUMI Americas**


MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world\-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.


### **What’s in it for you?**


*List at least two comparative wins for this role over another that someone might consider. Example follows.*


**Opportunity To Unlock Your Creativity**
  

Think of all the times you were held back from trying new ideas because you were boxed in by bureaucratic legacy processes or old school tactics. Having a growth mindset is deeply ingrained into our company culture since day 1 so Fictiv is an environment where you have the creative liberty and support of the team to try big bold ideas to achieve our sales and customer goals.


**Opportunity To Grow Your Career**
  

There are plenty of jobs out there. The question is whether any of them will help you grow in your career? Will you be challenged by teammates to achieve your potential? Or are they roles that will ask you to do more of what you've already mastered. At Fictiv, you'll be surrounded by supportive teammates who will push you to be your best through their curiosity and passion.  

  



**Impact In This Role:**


An HR Intern would provide meaningful execution support by working closely on the planning, coordination, documentation, follow\-up, and implementation of key initiatives. Helping in improving the speed and quality of execution while ensuring that important strategic priorities receive adequate attention.


The intent is therefore not to create an additional administrative layer, but to build execution capacity for critical HR initiatives and ensure that planned improvements are translated into tangible outcomes.


This role is for 6 months period of internship.

  

**What You’ll Be Doing:**


The intern will primarily support two categories of work:


**A. One\-Time / Priority Projects**


These initiatives require research, coordination, evaluation, and implementation support.


* Evaluation of Alternatives for Keka


* Replacement of BGV


* Replacement of Food Coupon Vendor


* Upcoming Insurance Renewal


**B. Build \& Evolve – Long\-Term HR Initiatives**


In addition to the immediate projects, the intern will support the development and continuous improvement of foundational HR practices.


* **Culture Alignment with Misumi Americas \-** Support initiatives that strengthen alignment with the culture, values, and expected ways of working.


* **Learning \& Development \-** Support the creation and execution of a structured Learning \& Development program


* **Employee Well\-Being \-** Support initiatives focused on employee engagement, well\-being, and overall employee experience.


* **Career Progression** \- Support the development of structured career progression frameworks and related documentation.


* **Process Mapping** \- Assist in documenting, reviewing, and improving IST operations related SOPs to ensure consistency, clarity, and scalability.


* **Performance Management** \- Support the development and implementation of effective performance management practices, including KPI definition, tracking, documentation, and process improvement.

  

**Desired Traits**


* Master’s in Business Administration/ Management in HR discipline.
* Empathy and Active Listening
* Strong Communication
* Discretion and Integrity
* Adaptability
  

**Interested in learning more? We look forward to hearing from you soon.**


We’re actively seeking teammates who:


* Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
* Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
* Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
* Have an ‘always learning’ mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
* Help us continue to build a world\-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates

We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

title: People Technology Delivery Lead
description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**  

  

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real\-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.  

  

This is an opportunity to do career\-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

**The Enterprise Technology Team**



The Enterprise Technology team builds and delivers the secure, scalable systems that power how our business runs. Our People Technology Team sits at the heart of this work, overseeing the full Hire\-to\-Retire technical ecosystem—including core applications like Workday, Greenhouse, and Cornerstone—and ensuring these platforms evolve alongside the company's growth. We partner closely with HR, Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, and Business Operations to bring data\-driven, compliant, and innovative solutions to life.


**The Opportunity**



Reporting to the Director of People Technology, this role will serve as a Delivery Lead and Principal Product Analyst for Okta's People Technology portfolio, focused on the **Growth \& Talent** pod. In this broad role, you will lead complex, multi\-system initiatives spanning Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, Performance, Learning, and Career Development. You will serve as the crucial conduit between Product Management, Recruiting/Talent Acquisition leadership, Talent Management, and People Operations, driving technical execution against a prioritized backlog to align with Okta's strategic workforce goals.


**What You'll Be Doing**


* **Strategic Leadership:** Technically scope and lead the delivery of multi\-quarter, high\-visibility, executive\-sponsored projects across the Growth \& Talent ecosystem (e.g., Greenhouse ATS integration \& workflows, Cornerstone L\&D platform optimization, and Workday Talent \& Performance solutions).
* **Subject Matter Expertise:** Serve as the functional specialist and delivery lead for the Growth \& Talent pod, specializing in talent acquisition, onboarding, performance management, succession planning, learning management, and career development technology integrations.
* **Core Systems Architecture \& Integration:** Partner with enterprise architects and delivery engineers to drive seamless end\-to\-end integrations across **Greenhouse** (Applicant Tracking System), **Cornerstone** (Learning \& Experience Platform), and **Workday** (Talent, Performance, Skills, and Core HCM).
* **Backlog \& Execution Management:** Drive delivery against a prioritized backlog for aligned Talent Acquisition and Talent Management stakeholder groups, ensuring successful project execution from start to finish.
* **Agile \& Scrum Execution:** Operate actively in a Scrum framework—breaking down complex epics and business requirements into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and actionable technical tasks while participating in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives.
* **Process Innovation \& AI Enablement:** Utilize functional and technical talent domain expertise to identify opportunities to optimize, automate, and innovate recruitment workflows, employee learning paths, and internal mobility through modern technology and AI capabilities.
* **Impediment Resolution:** Proactively identify and resolve project\-level risks, cross\-system integration blockers, and requirement trade\-offs with Talent Acquisition and Talent Management stakeholders to ensure on\-time delivery.
* **Mentorship \& Influence:** Guide project teams through uncertainty, facilitate technical scoping workshops, and provide mentorship to junior analysts and developers.
* **Stakeholder Partnership:** Act as the primary conduit between Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, and technical delivery teams, owning and writing detailed functional requirements, business process flows, data mappings, and use cases.

**What You'll Bring to the Role**


* **Experience:** 10\+ years of related experience in a professional People Technology / HRIS role with a Bachelor’s degree; or 6\+ years with a Master’s degree.
* **Domain \& System Expertise:** Deep functional and technical knowledge of core Growth \& Talent platforms, specifically **Greenhouse** (ATS), **Cornerstone** (LMS/L\&D), and **Workday Talent \& Performance** (Succession, Performance Reviews, Goals, Feedback, Skills).
* **Delivery Leadership:** Proven track record as a Delivery Lead managing complex, multi\-system HR technology initiatives, integrations, and feature rollouts.
* **Problem Solving \& Systems Analysis:** Ability to handle complex issues spanning multiple applications, data structures, and HR processes, requiring analysis of diverse data factors.
* **Collaboration \& Alignment:** Exceptional collaboration skills to build strong relationships with key stakeholders across Recruiting, HR Ops, and Talent Development, managing conflicting perspectives and reaching consensus.
* **Strategic Thinking:** Strategic mindset to anticipate future talent technology architecture needs, internal mobility initiatives, and proactive system optimizations.
* **Agile Leadership:** Strong leadership qualities to guide agile delivery pods, facilitate requirements workshops, and mentor team members.
* **Extra Credit:** Experience implementing AI/Automation use cases within HR tech (e.g., candidate matching, skill taxonomy mapping, automated learning pathways); relevant industry certifications (Workday Talent/Performance certifications, Agile/Scrum certification).

title: IAM Engineer
description:
We are looking for an IAM Engineer that would welcome the opportunity to work with a company that is in the fast\-growing market of providing whole\-home solutions around security and comfort. This is a tech\-oriented company that is expanding and growing and in need of an accomplished Engineer that loves to work as a team to solve complex technical problem.


This Engineer will provide the expertise, and design services for Microsoft AD, Azure AD, single sign\-on (SSO), virtual directory services (VDS), multi\-factor authentication (MFA), identity governance \& administration (IGA), public key infrastructure (PKI), and identity federation for the enterprise. Work closely with IT and business partners to ensure identity and access solutions meet or exceed security policies and regulatory compliance requirements. This role will provide technical leadership, subject matter expertise, and direction on complex projects in the corporate IAM space at the highest levels of the organization.


**JOB DUTIES:**

* Partners with Enterprise Architecture to develop strategies and standards for IAM solutions.
* Serve as the technical subject matter expert, thought leader, and one of the key decision makers for IAM as it relates to infrastructure integration, cloud security, network, and other platform related security efforts.
* Defines and documents the proposed, high\-level solution, including the use of Commercial Off the Shelf (COTS) packages to create solutions.
* Analyzes technical risks and advises on risk mitigation strategies.
* Responsible for the technical content (architecture and design), integrity, and quality of proposed solutions.
* Defines and documents the actions needed to close architecture gaps in support of business objectives.
* Responsible for the technical content (architecture and design), integrity, and quality of solution.
* Identifies new technologies and development tools as required.
* Analyzes available assets (frameworks, reference architectures, etc.) to bridge the gap between the as\-is architecture and the to\-be architecture.
* Participates in the design, implementation and integration of Active Directory services in support of Azure, AWS, Sailpoint, PingFederate, and Office 365\.
* Ensure that all IAM functionality and integrations across the enterprise conform to security standards.

**YOU MUST HAVE:**

* Ability to work in team environment on assigned tasks and multiple large projects.
* 10\+ years of technical IT infrastructure work experience.
* 8\+ years of IAM administration and design experience that includes most of the following: AD, IGA, SSO, VDS, MFA, PKI, SAML.
* Entry/Mid\-level Azure / AWS technical knowledge.
* Proven track record operating in a lead technical role in large enterprise with multiple IAM services environments: AD services, LDAP, interfaces with HR software, MFA, scripting, replication, certificates, performance, troubleshooting, monitoring, disaster recovery, security \& administration…

**WE VALUE:**

* Working knowledge of hybrid infrastructure technologies (ESXi, VMware Cloud, server, network, storage, load balancing clustering, etc.).
* Experience with enterprise infrastructure (including cloud) security principles, policies, and compliance.
* Hands on experience building large scale application deployments, standard three tier web application.
* Operating systems experience – Windows Server, RHEL, CentOS.
* Ability to communicate clearly and professional verbally and written.
* Experience working directly with customers in a consultative capacity.
* Motivated and calm under pressure.
* Relevant certifications: CIST, CIAM, CISSP, Cloud Solution Architect

  

  

**WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Health Insurance Coverage


* Education Assistance


* Maternity \& Paternity Leave


* Menstrual Wellness Benefit


* Bereavement Leave

title: Manager –Transition & Project Management
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose\-driven, world\-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  

  

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  

  

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.


**About the Role:**

The Global Transition and Transformation function has oversight and end to end delivery accountability for a wide portfolio of transformation programs and projects spanning Operating Model, Process and Enterprise level transformation. Your role therefore is pivotal to front\-ending and delivering the Operating Model transformation road map for Haleon.


* **Transition Scoping and planning:**
* Facilitate discovery workshops and document transition scope. Plan follow\-ups where required.
* Facilitate planning workshops; develop and baseline the end\-end transition roadmap / plan.
* **Business Case:** Closely monitor spend; manage baseline changes through change control.
* **Governance:**
	+ Partner with the Global PMO to ensure toll gate criteria are well defined relative to the transition nature and tollgates are orchestrated in line with the transition plan. Prepare content for tollgates.
	+ Prepare status reports on overall transition health for report\-out at weekly governance. Leverage standard tooling and best practices as prescribed by the Global PMO for status updates.
* **Detailed Design / Solutioning, Knowledge Transfer (KT) planning:**
* Consolidate outcomes of the detailed design for report\-out.
* Facilitate Knowledge Transfer planning workshops covering all aspects of the processes to be transitioned with clear alignment on scope, trainers, timelines, and ways of working.
* **Recruitment, Onboarding, Knowledge Transfer (KT):**
	+ Participate in recruitment steer cos; ensure HR gets required support from business to hire at pace.
	+ Align with IT requirements and raise provisioning requests in line with onboarding timelines.
	+ Onboard new joiners and orient / deploy for KT in accordance with the KT plan.

* **Stakeholder Management:** Plan stakeholder connects at an agreed cadence to keep them informed of the transition progress. Maintain a stakeholder log evidencing stakeholder engagement (Actions from the meetings, follow up plans etc.)

* **Facilitate** **Governance** **\& actions Management**
* Chair and lead the partnership governance
* Partner with the Enterprise Transformation office and represent HBS in TO governance
* Collect and Co\-ordinate Actions into the Programme Team
* Ensure that the Actions Board is being proactively managed
* Identify escalations to bring to Programme Leadership

* **RAID Management**
	+ Collect and Create Appropriate Programme Level Risk and Issues records
	+ Facilitate RAID log review meetings, identifying those RAID Items to be covered at the next review, and managing the invitee list appropriately
	+ Ensure that the collected RAID items are being proactively managed
	+ Identify escalations to bring to Programme Leadership

* **Change Control Management**
	+ Create Relevant Change Controls on behalf of the Programme
	+ Manage the Change Board invite based upon scope of Change Items to be presented
	+ Action any approved changes, updating the key Programme artefacts
	+ Communicating outcomes from the Change Board

**Qualifications \& Skills:**

* 7\+ years demonstrated experience of transitioning processes from local markets to Shared Services Captives, Outsourcing partners etc.
* Transition management experience across multiple functions (Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, Tech etc.) in a Consumer goods company is a plus, but not mandatory
* Demonstrated proficiency in project, program, portfolio management processes and principles
* Demonstrated experience delivering projects through both Agile and waterfall approach is desirable.
* Demonstrated resilience in navigating through complex and ambiguous change.
* Excellent interpersonal (communication and presentation) and organizational skills
* Hands on experience on PM tools – Example MS Project, MS P4W, Jira, Confluence, Teams
* Good to have Certifications – PMP, Prince 2

This is a unique opportunity to influence change, interact with global stakeholders on projects and programs that drive a real impact to the Haleon businesses. Your ability to ‘make things happen’ coupled with a ‘positive can\-do attitude’ will set you up for success in this role.  



 **Job Posting End Date**

2026\-09\-26  

**Equal Opportunities**
-----------------------

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  

  

During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  

  

The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.  



**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
----------------------------------------

If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.  



**Note to candidates**
----------------------

The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

title: Operation Manager
description:
Job Description: Operations Manager – BPO

Job Title: Operations Manager

Department: Operations

Location: Mathikere

Employment Type: Full\-Time

Job Summary

The Operations Manager is responsible for managing day\-to\-day BPO operations, ensuring delivery of client SLAs, achieving business KPIs, driving team performance, and maintaining high standards of quality, compliance, and customer satisfaction. The role involves leading large teams, improving operational efficiency, and building strong client relationships.

Key Responsibilities

\* Manage end\-to\-end operations and ensure achievement of SLAs and KPIs.

\* Lead, coach, and develop Team Leaders and Process Associates.

\* Monitor productivity, quality, TAT, CSAT, and operational performance.

\* Drive continuous process improvements and operational excellence.

\* Manage client escalations and participate in governance reviews.

\* Ensure compliance with client requirements and company policies.

\* Analyze MIS reports and implement action plans for performance improvement.

\* Partner with Quality, Training, HR, and Workforce Management teams.

\* Drive employee engagement, retention, and succession planning.

\* Ensure effective resource planning and cost optimization.

Required Qualifications

4–6 years of experience in BPO operations, with at least 2–3 years in a managerial role.

Key Skills:

\* Operations \& Service Delivery Management

\* People Leadership

\* Client \& Stakeholder Management

\* SLA/KPI Management

\* Performance Management

\* Problem Solving \& Decision Making

\* Process Improvement

\* MIS \& Reporting

\* Excellent Communication Skills

\* Advanced MS Excel and PowerPoint

\* Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

\* SLA Compliance

\* Productivity

\* Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)

\* Turnaround Time (TAT)

\* Attrition \& Shrinkage

\* Employee Engagement

\* Client Satisfaction

Preferred Experience:

Experience in Voice, Banking, Financial Services, Healthcare, Insurance, Telecom, or E\-commerce BPO operations.

Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Manager: Learning platform management
description:
**What we are looking for**

Support the management of the technology landscape of State Street Talent development and learning, managing end\-to\-end Learning Management System (LMS) with exposure to integration and curation mechanics. Exposure to learning experience platform (LXP) is definite plus.


Support the execution of the strategic Learning and Talent development strategy and ensures alignment of technology and content to the objectives \& priorities.


The role will interact closely with other Learning functions including Enterprise learning solutions, talent Consultancy, talent management, leadership development, Design \& development and HR Business partners that technology is successfully implemented and is meeting the needs of learning. The role will also interact with State Street HR tech and IT for design, integration, IT support and adoption of new technologies.


The incumbent will report to Head – learning technology and curation. The position is location agnostic to the present State Street office cities.


**Skill required:**

Platform management \| System Migration \| Platform implementation \| Integration management \| Data Analytics \| Learning management System \| Learning Agility \| Solution centricity \| Ability to work under pressure \| Teamwork

  

  

**What you will be responsible for:**

* Execute learning and talent technology strategy. At the direction of the Learning Tech \& Curation Lead work to establish the enterprise\-wide approach to learning and talent technology platform management. This strategy works with learning platforms such as learning management system (LMS) as primary requirement and supporting learning experience platform (LXP). This involved optimal LMS implementation set\-up, migration management, integration with content providers and other platforms in learning, video communication (WebEx/Zoom) and talent platforms.
* Platform management and maintenance. Configuration, Integration, migration, release management and administration experience with learning management systems.
* Support the administration of learning and talent technologies. Support day\-to\-day ongoing operations activities including maintenance, usage, analysis, reporting, L3, integration and administration of the learning technologies.
* Curation mindset. Exposure to optimize learning assets across the organization
* Participate in establishing structure, governance, and context to manage platforms.
* Manage the learner experience with technology. Support the required infrastructure, tools, and integrations to promote a technology\-enabled learning culture.
* Partner with internal stakeholders, curation manager, technology teams and external information to offer customized and vetted selection of the most effective and relevant resources.
* As per required business priorities and strategy changes, willingness to perform other work duties from time to time.

  

**Preferred Qualification and skills**

* Degree level qualification or relevant professional qualification
* Broad experience in the Learning and talent technology space, preferable (not compulsory) in financial institutions.
* High learning agility (ability \& curiosity to learn new skills, new technology and changing dynamics of the work objectives) is a required skill.
* Have worked with LMS (preferably but not limited to CSOD) at the level of configuration, release management, user and access management as solution management perspective (and not just administration management) – Similar experience in LXP (like Degreed, Edcast etc.) is preferable but not compulsory.
* Preferably worked on most of activities like migration management, system analysis, SSO requests, certificate management, API and content collectors integration.
* Excellent data management analysis using MS Excel. Exposure to any other data analysis tool is a plus but not compulsory
* Strong project management skills, ability to execute project plans on a regional and global scale. Tactical planning experience with excellent interpersonal skills
* This role requires a high caliber learning technology professional with broad learning technology platform management experience. A positive can\-do attitude and ability to navigate ambiguity will be key success factors.
* Ability to apply and leverage technology while working across regions and functions are critical elements of the role. Understanding of learning \& talent assets curation and optimization is required plus.
* Authenticity, Empathy and being a very strong team player with collaborative solution\-centric mind\-set is non\-negotiable requirement of this role.
* LMS, PMP and MS office certification (not compulsory)

**About State Street**
======================

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.


We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work\-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.


As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

title: Administrative Assistant III
description:
**We Are Teva**
---------------



We’re Teva, a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company, enabled by a world\-class generics business. Whether it’s innovating in the fields of neuroscience and immunology or delivering high\-quality medicine worldwide, we’re dedicated to addressing patients’ needs now and in the future. Here, you will be part of a high\-performing, inclusive culture that values fresh thinking and collaboration. You'll have the room to grow, the flexibility to balance life with work, and the opportunity to better health worldwide, together.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------



The Executive Assistant will provide high\-quality administrative, coordination, and operational support to the R\&D India leadership team and designated senior global leaders. The role is critical in enabling seamless calendar management, meeting coordination, stakeholder engagement, documentation, travel support, and administrative operations across internal and external stakeholders.

**How You’ll Spend Your Day**
-----------------------------


* Executive Support and Calendar Management.


Manage calendars for senior leaders, including scheduling, prioritization, time\-zone coordination, and meeting logistics.  

Coordinate domestic and international travel, accommodation, itineraries, and expense submissions.  

Prepare leaders for meetings by collating documents, background materials,agendas, and pre\-read materials.  

Meeting Coordination and Follow\-up  

Plan and coordinate leadership meetings, cross\-functional reviews, workshops,town halls, and ad hoc discussions.  

Prepare agendas, record minutes, track action items, and follow up on deadlines.  

Coordinate meeting rooms, virtual links, attendee communication, and logistics.

* R\&D India Administrative Operations


Provide administrative support for the R\&D India unit to ensure smooth day\-to\-day operations.  

Coordinate with Facilities, Security, IT, HR, Finance, Procurement, and other internal functions.Support R\&D portal updates and other internal communication or documentation activities.  

Maintain organized records, files, trackers, and documentation with accuracy and confidentiality.

* External Partner and Stakeholder Support


Support communication and scheduling with candidates, vendors, academic partners, and external stakeholders.  

Provide logistical support for partner meetings, site visits, offsite meetings, and external engagements.  

Draft routine correspondence and manage meeting requests professionally.


R\&D Academy and Internal Programs  

Support R\&D Academy administrative activities, including scheduling, participant coordination, faculty communication, logistics, attendance tracking, and documentation.  

Assist in organizing internal events, team sessions, workshops, and engagement activities.

* Systems and Process Support


Use internal systems for workflows related to purchase orders, contracts, expense reporting, financial tracking, and stakeholder documentation.  

Identify opportunities to improve administrative processes, consistency, and  

efficiency.

**Your Qualification and Experience**
-------------------------------------


* Minimum 5 years of experience supporting senior leaders in a multinational organization, preferably in pharmaceuticals, healthcare, R\&D, business operations,corporate affairs, or external\-facing functions.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, and enterprise collaboration tools.
* Excellent calendar management, meeting coordination, documentation, and followup skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with professional presence.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities independently in a dynamic environment.
* High level of discretion and ability to handle confidential information.
* Basic understanding of R\&D functions in the pharmaceutical industry preferred.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree preferred, ideally in life sciences, business administration, or a related discipline. Equivalent experience may also be  

considered.
**How We’ll Take Care of You**
------------------------------



At Teva India, care is at the heart of how we work. From your first day, you’ll be welcomed into a people\-first culture built on inclusion, respect, and belonging.


That support extends to you and your loved ones through benefits designed for real life. These include comprehensive medical insurance, OPD coverage, annual health checkups, term life and accident insurance, and confidential emotional wellbeing support through our Optum Employee Assistance Program. You’ll also enjoy healthy meals at work, holistic wellbeing initiatives, and volunteering programs that help you give back to the community.


Your growth matters too. You’ll have opportunities to build future\-ready skills, collaborate on projects with global teams, explore internal career opportunities, and learn through programs such as our AI\-enabled Teva Twist program, R\&D Academy, continuing education, and mentorship.

  

Join our vibrant workplace, where we celebrate milestones, festivals, achievements, and community impact together.

**Teva’s Equal Employment Opportunity Commitment**
--------------------------------------------------


Teva Pharmaceuticals is committed to equal opportunity in employment. It is Teva's global policy that equal employment opportunity be provided without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, disability, pregnancy, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, ancestry, veteran status, national or ethnic origin or any other legally recognized status entitled to protection under applicable laws. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace for all. If you are contacted for a job opportunity, please advise us of any accommodations needed to support you throughout the recruitment and selection process. All accommodation information provided will be treated as confidential and used only for the purpose of providing an accessible candidate experience.

title: CTK Svc Associate
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer\-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want \- low prices, vast selection, and convenience \- Amazon.com continues to grow and evolve as a world\-class e\-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from Web site to e\-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon.com to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.
  

  

About Amazon Centralized Timekeeping  

  

The vision of the Centralized Timekeeping team is to utilize top talent to streamline time and attendance data entry, reduce payroll defects and provide consistently high service levels. Today, CTK supports and manages time and attendance matters for thousands of Amazon Associates. Requests for edits are submitted via trouble ticketing from operators and HR across the network. The Centralized team manages the ticket queue by executing on the requests on a FIFO basis but will prioritize any payroll impacting ticket if there is a risk of a payroll defect. The efforts of this team support the business by ensuring associate’s time and attendance matters are handled with speed, precision and with customer obsession always in mind.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or Advanced Degree
* Experience performing accurate data entry and analysis
* Experience working in a large team or fast\-paced corporate environment, or experience participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results
* Experience owning end\-to\-end programs to drive results

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience working with Windows, Word, Excel, MyTime (Kronos) and PowerPoint
* Experience in administrative tasks such as data entry, managing data driven report processes or processes
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or experience with MS Office Suite, CRMs (Salesforce) and other systems
* 6\+ months of human resources experience

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
